svg.text: 2 Trough on the frame (free end open)
orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
bar Ø63.8 through drive throat and both Ø80 plate holes: free
ribbons do not touch the shell while sliding: guide by hand
gasket edge flush with the inside, no step
H1 x8 M16, 120 N·m; H5 set screws
15 ±3 ribbon to plate both ends; turn by hand: 4..6 ribbon gap
follower square, 10 [.39] gap left for adjustment
H6 per NORD; H7 bushes just compress
no side load: motor hangs free on the arm
cover lands evenly, gasket 3 ±0.5; sensor gap 5
1. Step 1: Set frame 400 on the marked location; shim feet level within 1 [.04]; drill and set anchors.
2. Step 2: Lift trough 100 (≈ 100 kg) with a spreader; lugs on the rails over the sleeves. Free-end plate 110 OFF.
3. Step 3: Sling the agitator 200 (≈ 53 kg) at the shaft between arms, slide it in from the free end, drive journal through the drive throat and plate.
4. Step 4: Gasket 111 and free-end plate 110 over the free shaft end, onto the ring 108.
5. Step 5: Slide SUCF212 bearings on both ends; centre the shaft in both throats (2 [.08] radial gap all round), then torque; set axial position.
6. Step 6: Packing: 4 rings 10 sq per box, joints 90° apart; follower; studs.
7. Step 7: Gearmotor: key H12, food-grade anti-seize, slide onto the Ø45 journal, retaining screw; torque arm to bracket 408 (drill bracket now).
8. Step 8: Valve P1-331 + clamp; level switch P1-337; panel CP-301 on rails 410; wire per E01..E04.
9. Step 9: Cover 300: hinge pins H10; gasket P1-339 on the flange land; latches + keepers and interlock (drill on assembly).
10. Step 10: Commission per P1-301-900: rotation, interlock, STO, run-in, product trial.
11. Lifting: trough + agitator ≈ 155 kg [340 lb]: use the shop hoist or a gantry, never lift by the shaft ends or the stuffing boxes.
12. Agitator removal for maintenance is the reverse of steps 7, 6, 5, 4, 3 (cover open, valve off).
